name: exp00_data
title: Data preparation: geometries, qubit hamiltonians and reference energies
description: Every geometry used in the experiments (H₂, H₄ chain, and LiH for the next step) taken through the whole pipeline: PySCF integrals, parity-mapped qubit hamiltonian, HF / CCSD / FCI references. Logs the size of each encoding and checks that the qubit hamiltonian reproduces FCI and is identical between builds.

config.orbital_signs: largest coefficient of every MO made positive (hamiltonians.fix_orbital_signs)
config.splits: geometries of every experiment and their role: exp00_data_splits.csv
